label: Agency owner
name: Management agency owner on working with Unbanz
description: A management agency owner talks about using Unbanz for unbans, account removals and username claims for their clients.
transcript: So, I run a management agency and I've been working with Unbanz for the last 3 months now. They're handling all the bans and unbans, username claims for my clients, taking down accounts, photos, so if you need help with Facebook or Instagram related, hit them up.

label: Ad account
name: Restricted Facebook ad account restored by Unbanz
description: A client explains how Unbanz got her restricted Facebook ad account back so she could run ads again.
transcript: Hey, my Facebook ad account was restricted and I was unable to run ads. ChatGPT recommended me Unbanz and they got it back within a week. If you need help with your ad accounts, hit them up.
